chip.description: Dot-matrix character LCD controller/driver: generates the character raster from display-data RAM and a character-generator ROM and drives the panel directly.
chip.notes: Classified per video sub-guide V3 (character layer generated from a map plus character ROM, with display shift): it generates pixel content, so it is not a video-crtc, and it has no sprites, so it is not a video-ppu.
